[size=2]Fixes for known mod incompatibilities[/size]
[size=2][spoiler]
(Seasonal Cute Characters) - For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url], go into it's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Menu[/url]﻿ config and untick the box next to "FarmerBase"
(Get Glam) - For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url]﻿ get it's Compatibility Patch from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16566?tab=files&file_id=77682]here﻿[/url]﻿ & follow the usage guide in the file.
(Egghead Farmer) - For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19159]Egghead Farmer[/url]﻿ get it's Compatability Patch from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16566?tab=files&file_id=78601]here[/url]﻿ & follow the usage guide in the file.

[/spoiler][/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/n0BYF4c/Installation.png[/img]﻿

[color=#ffffff][size=2]I. Install[/size][/color][/size][size=3][color=#ffffff][size=2] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
II. Download Heterochromia
III. Unzip & Place the folder named "Heterochromia" in your mod folder
IV. Start the game using SMAPI[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kJGb69R/Usage-Guide.png[/img]﻿[/color]

[size=1](Having transparent eyes before you select the ones in fashion sense is normal)[/size]
[size=2]I. Get the Fashion Sense mirror by choosing to start with it (recommended) or from Pierre's store
II. Open the mirror's GUI and go to the accessory section
III. Choose your left & right eyes and their colors
IV. If you're using a overlay, make sure that it's selected after the eye, for example: 1 (left eye) < 2 (left shaded overlay)
